cards.title: Slide 2
cards.subtitle: Product Cost Simulator & Multi-Tier BOM Explosion

description.plain:
Multi-week quotation latency: Cross-functional teams spend 10–18 days manually consolidating multi-level BOMs, outdated purchase info records, and work center rates.

Volatile commodity & FX risk blindness: Unanticipated price shifts in steel, copper, energy tariffs, and foreign exchange erode projected tender margins by 8–15% post-award.

Rigid ERP costing structures: Core SAP S/4HANA CK11N/CK40N costing runs are static, require released master data, and cannot run dynamic pre-deal "what-if" simulations without risking productive costing data integrity.

cards.title: Card 7 — Prerequisites & next step
cards.subtitle: Product Cost Simulator & Multi-Tier BOM Explosion

description.plain:
BTP services + entitlements — SAP BTP Cloud Foundry Runtime (1–2 GB memory), SAP BTP Destination Service (Standard), SAP Authorization & Trust Management (XSUAA), SAP Cloud Connector (for on-prem S/4HANA), SAP AI Core (Phase 2 predictive tender pricing).

S/4HANA config / authorizations — SAP S/4HANA 1909+ (Cloud or On-Premise); Communication Arrangements for BOM (SAP_COM_0002), Routing (SAP_COM_0028), Product Master (SAP_COM_0008), PIR (SAP_COM_0053), Sales Quotation (SAP_COM_0079); Read access to CO-PC and MM valuation views.

architecture.title: Product Cost Simulator & Multi-Tier BOM Explosion — Enterprise Blueprint
architecture.subtitle: Modular 3-Tier decoupled cloud topology compliant with SAP Clean Core mandate.

tiers.name: Tier 1: Experience & UI Layer
tiers.text: Responsive SAP Fiori Horizon UI, React 19 micro-frontends, role-based Launchpad, and mobile offline capabilities.

tiers.name: Tier 2: SAP BTP Cloud Foundry & AI Core
tiers.text: Node.js CAP runtime, asynchronous Event Mesh pub/sub queuing, SAP Generative AI Hub, and automated tenant isolation.

tiers.name: Tier 3: SAP S/4HANA Clean Core System of Record
tiers.text: Released CDS Views, standard OData v4 APIs, and touchless transaction settlement without modifying ERP standard tables.
